title: Geekvape Aegis Force Pod Vape Kit
description: The Geek Vape Aegis Force Kit continues the legendary durability and performance of the Aegis lineage, offering a powerful yet compact pod mod designed for vapers who need reliability in tough environments. At the heart of the device is a substantial 3200mAh built-in battery. This impressive capacity rivals single-18650 devices, supporting the kit's 80W maximum output and ensuring extended run-times for high-wattage DTL vaping. Built to endure, the Aegis Force features a robust chassis designed to withstand the rigours of daily life. It is powered by an intelligent chipset that includes "Smart Mode," which automatically detects the installed coil and sets the optimal wattage limit to prevent burning. For advanced users, the device also offers precise Temperature Control modes. Operation is streamlined by the signature "A-Lock" switch, a physical slider that instantly locks the device to prevent accidental firing in pockets or bags. The kit utilizes the Geek Vape Aegis Force Cartridge, which features a leak-resistant top airflow system. This design channels air down to the coil for superior flavour while keeping e-liquid securely contained. The device is fully compatible with the Geek Vape B-Series Coil platform, offering a wide range of resistances for everything from tight MTL draws to powerful DTL clouds. Two drip tips, DTL and MTL, are included in the box to facilitate your preferred inhale style. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
